name: HKDAP
collateral: 1:1 HKD-denominated high-quality liquid assets held in segregated accounts under HKMA Stablecoins Ordinance requirements
launchPhaseDetail: First licensed HKD stablecoin under Hong Kong's Stablecoins Ordinance; JV between Standard Chartered, HKT, and Animoca Brands; 1:1 backed by HKD-denominated high-quality liquid assets; phased B2B2C rollout targeting Q2 2026 for RWA settlement and cross-border payments

featuredContent.title: Animoca-backed Anchorpoint to launch regulated HKD stablecoin HKDAP
featuredContent.description: Standard Chartered, HKT, and Animoca Brands JV receives first HKMA stablecoin license for HKD-pegged HKDAP.

milestones.title: HKMA awards first stablecoin license to Anchorpoint Financial
milestones.description: Standard Chartered / HKT / Animoca Brands JV becomes first licensed HKD stablecoin issuer under Hong Kong's Stablecoins Ordinance.
